children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Monday, and the yield on benchmark government debt slipped.
was trading 0.4% lower at C$1.4037 to the greenback, or 71.24 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3984 to 1.4038.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) fell 3.3 basis points to 3.845%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt fell to 4.9633%.
futures fell $4.52 to settle at $95.78 a barrel on Monday.
